decisions.reason: A safety shoe line fits the firm's core business and costs little to keep, and one year on the market does not yet show its value, so the option stays open.
The comfort insole is a low-cost accessory that complements the shoe range, and its results are still uncertain, so keeping it preserves upside cheaply.
The supportive insole overlaps with the other insoles and is only mentioned on the website, but the cost of keeping it is low and its value is still unresolved.
The ergonomic series has its own page, which signals commitment and early promise, so the firm should keep it while its prospects play out.
Firefighter boots serve a specialized segment with long certification and procurement cycles, so it is too early to judge them and the option is worth holding.
The moulded insole is featured on the home page, which suggests positive early signals, so the firm should keep it to learn more before committing further.
